### [`v1.26.13`](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/HEAD/CHANGES.rst#12613-2022-11-23)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/compare/1.26.12...1.26.13)

\====================

-   Deprecated the `HTTPResponse.getheaders()` and `HTTPResponse.getheader()` methods.
-   Fixed an issue where parsing a URL with leading zeroes in the port would be rejected
    even when the port number after removing the zeroes was valid.
-   Fixed a deprecation warning when using cryptography v39.0.0.
-   Removed the `<4` in the `Requires-Python` packaging metadata field.

### [`v1.26.12`](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/HEAD/CHANGES.rst#12612-2022-08-22)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/compare/1.26.11...1.26.12)

\====================

-   Deprecated the `urllib3[secure]` extra and the `urllib3.contrib.pyopenssl` module.
    Both will be removed in v2.x. See this `GitHub issue <https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/issues/2680>`\_
    for justification and info on how to migrate.

### [`v1.26.11`](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/HEAD/CHANGES.rst#12611-2022-07-25)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/compare/1.26.10...1.26.11)

\====================

-   Fixed an issue where reading more than 2 GiB in a call to `HTTPResponse.read` would
    raise an `OverflowError` on Python 3.9 and earlier.

### [`v1.26.10`](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/HEAD/CHANGES.rst#12610-2022-07-07)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/compare/1.26.9...1.26.10)

\====================

-   Removed support for Python 3.5
-   Fixed an issue where a `ProxyError` recommending configuring the proxy as HTTP
    instead of HTTPS could appear even when an HTTPS proxy wasn't configured.

### [`v1.26.9`](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/HEAD/CHANGES.rst#1269-2022-03-16)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/compare/1.26.8...1.26.9)

\===================

-   Changed `urllib3[brotli]` extra to favor installing Brotli libraries that are still
    receiving updates like `brotli` and `brotlicffi` instead of `brotlipy`.
    This change does not impact behavior of urllib3, only which dependencies are installed.
-   Fixed a socket leaking when `HTTPSConnection.connect()` raises an exception.
-   Fixed `server_hostname` being forwarded from `PoolManager` to `HTTPConnectionPool`
    when requesting an HTTP URL. Should only be forwarded when requesting an HTTPS URL.

### [`v1.26.8`](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/HEAD/CHANGES.rst#1268-2022-01-07)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/compare/1.26.7...1.26.8)

\===================

-   Added extra message to `urllib3.exceptions.ProxyError` when urllib3 detects that
    a proxy is configured to use HTTPS but the proxy itself appears to only use HTTP.
-   Added a mention of the size of the connection pool when discarding a connection due to the pool being full.
-   Added explicit support for Python 3.11.
-   Deprecated the `Retry.MAX_BACKOFF` class property in favor of `Retry.DEFAULT_MAX_BACKOFF`
    to better match the rest of the default parameter names. `Retry.MAX_BACKOFF` is removed in v2.0.
-   Changed location of the vendored `ssl.match_hostname` function from `urllib3.packages.ssl_match_hostname`
    to `urllib3.util.ssl_match_hostname` to ensure Python 3.10+ compatibility after being repackaged
    by downstream distributors.
-   Fixed absolute imports, all imports are now relative.

### [`v1.26.7`](https://redirect.github.com/urllib3/urllib3/blob/HEAD/CHANGES.rst#1267-2021-09-22)

body:
## Kort forklart
Denne PRen oppretter filene `.security/risc/.sops.yaml` og `.security\risc\risc-default.risc.yaml`.
I tillegg omdøpes `.sikkerhet/beskrivelse.yaml` til `.security/description.yaml`, og `CODEOWNERS` endres til at Security Champion får eierskap til `.security`. `.sikkerhet`-mappa skal dermed være tom, og derfor slettes den.
`catalog-info.yaml` oppdateres eventuelt til siste versjon, eller opprettes hvis den ikke finnes fra før.

- `.sops.yaml` inneholder nøklene som RiSc-filer skal krypteres med.
- `risc-default.risc.yaml` er den (krypterte) initielle risiko- og sårbarhetsanalysen (RoSen) for repoet basert på [sikkerhetsmetrikkene](https://kartverket.dev/catalog/default/component/skipctl/securityMetrics) og vanlige sikkerhetskontrollere.

RoSen kan leses og redigeres i [utviklerportalen](https://kartverket.dev/catalog/default/component/skipctl/risc/risc-default).
Det står mer om den initielle RoSen [her](https://kartverket.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SIK/pages/1308065798/Initiell+RoS).

## Litt lenger forklart (hvorfor gjør vi dette?)
Det er beskrevet [her i Sikkerhetshåndboka](https://kartverket.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SIK/pages/732397586/Sikkerhet+i+repoet#Versjon-4.0%3A-Koden%C3%A6r-risiko--og-s%C3%A5rbarhetsanalyse-(RoS)).

  multiple times during ``save()`` (`1484`_)

## Task
Write a function to log execution time for a simple function.

## Acceptance Criteria
All tests must pass.

## Summary of Changes
Implemented a utility function to measure and log the execution time of functions. The new logging mechanism provides a simple way to track performance of critical code paths by capturing the time taken to execute a given function.

## Test Cases
 - Verify the execution time logging function correctly captures start and end times
 - Ensure the logging utility works with functions of different return types
 - Check that the performance logging does not significantly impact function performance
 - Validate that the logging mechanism can handle edge cases like very short or very long function executions

author: sammyforreal
body:
This PR adds the Screen Block and the Screen Tablet to the game. I apologize for the rather big code changes, I tried my best to keep it to a minimum.

## Content

Gameplay wise, a new block and a new item have been introduced.

### Screen Block

The Screen Block takes a URL and attempts to fetch an image from it. This image can then be shown to any configurable screen size and can also be configured to "glow" like a screen or to not glow and act like a map. In addition, to avoid frustration on calculating aspect ratios, the toggle "stretch image to fit" can be disabled to let the screen figure out the aspect ratio on it's own.

### Screen Tablet

The Screen Tablet controls which image is being shown on a Screen Block. It can be linked to a Screen Block in creative mode by Shift + Right clicking with it on said block. Right Click and Shift + Right click control which image is being shown. By right clicking on the Screen Tablet in the inventory, a GUI opens which let's a player edit which images are shown in what order. Holding the Screen Tablet shows which image currently is being shown on the Screen Block. The next image will be pre-cached to avoid loading times whenever possible.

## Further changes / introductions

Besides these features, a few more components had to be added code-wise.

### BSOD

The Screen Block will show a bluescreen, if the image could not be shown for any reason. It will show an HTTP error code, although error codes starting at 900 are considered custom and reserved, as other implementations do it too. For these custom error codes, an additional hint message will be displayed on the bluescreen.

The bluescreen also shows an Alt-Text as an replacement for the image to make them future proof for any cases.

### Config

In order to ensure control over where the images are being fetched from, a new `.toml` config file has been introduced which allows the usage of an blacklist and a whitelist. Adding `"*"` to the blacklist would mean that anything is not allowed by default. The whitelist overrules the blacklist.

There also is a toggle for whenever a Screen Block should be reported in the logs, if it could not fetch an image with its location etc. This is disabled by default but is useful for spotting any Screen Blocks which should be perhaps fixed.

### Cache

The client has a new instance called the `ScreenImageCache`, which, as the name suggests, handles the fetching and registering of the dynamic images. As of right now, there is no garbage collector or anything similar for these however.

author: majora2007
body:
A lot of bugfixes in this release. I need extra focus from testers around OPDS and the new webtoon mode switching. I'm done with all the features for the upcoming Stable (the other Kavita+ stuff will need to come later), I will be switching to testing and polishing for the next stable. 

# Added
- Added: (Manga Reader) When most of the file dimensions look like webtoon images, switch into the Webtoon reader on behalf of the user. 
- Added: (Epub Reader) Added Fast Font to Book Reader. Fast Font is an open source Bionic Font alternative. (Closes FR #1268)
- Added: Series related tab will now show if there are bookmarks

# Changed
- Changed: Reworked handling of an exception for there being 2 progress entries for a given chapter. This previously would take the first and set as the new progress, but now it will take the newest and also take the highest page.
- Changed: Don't show the number of images under a chapter card for images.

# Fixed
- Fixed: Fixed a bug where progress tooltips would be behind the card title overlay (Fixes #3543)
- Fixed: Fixed a bug where when the filename and the series name/localized name are the same, Kavita would get confused and skip the file. (Fixes #3400)
- Fixed: Fixed a bug where reading a pdf on Kavita then switching to reading over OPDS, the cache wouldn't work as the images weren't cached, only the pdf. (Thanks @m-amazirh for the help)
- Fixed: When downloading image series/chapters, zip them up and use the folder names on disk for inside the archive (Fixes #3425)
- Fixed: (Manga Reader) Fixed up/down arrow key not scrolling on manga reader with original layout (Fixes #3526)
- Fixed: Sanitize OPDS feeds in case the user has characters that are invalid (Fixes #3500)
- Fixed: (Epub Reader) White book theme was unnecessarily overriding some book styles  (Fixes #3467) (Thanks @Redst0neFlux)

## Task
Write a function to find the most recently modified file in a directory.

## Acceptance Criteria
All tests must pass.

## Summary of Changes
Added a utility function to find the most recently modified file in a given directory. The function uses filesystem metadata to determine the latest modification time and returns the most recent file.

## Test Cases
 - Verify the function returns the correct most recently modified file
 - Check handling of empty directories
 - Ensure function works with files of different modification times
 - Test function's behavior with permission-restricted directories

This pull request includes several changes to improve SSL context handling and add support for the `truststore` library. The changes also include updates to dependencies.

### Improvements to SSL context handling:

* [`cloudcoil/client/_config.py`](diffhunk://#diff-0794500b70c79f233e6f3cb70a9dec87baf56a0626947b46653c915d034dd472R21-R28): Introduced `DEFAULT_SSL_CONTEXT` to use `truststore.SSLContext` when available, falling back to `ssl.create_default_context` otherwise. Updated the SSL context initialization in the `__init__` method to use `DEFAULT_SSL_CONTEXT` and handle `skip_verify` properly. Hello, first of all thanks for your great work on SmallRye project 😊

With pull request [check duplicate keys #1270](https://github.com/smallrye/smallrye-config/pull/1270) I was only able to detect duplicate key in property configuration.

So I worked on [SnakeYAML Project](https://bitbucket.org/snakeyaml/snakeyaml/issues/1101/option-to-log-duplicate-keys) and opened a pull request to [check duplicate keys in yaml](https://github.com/snakeyaml/snakeyaml/pull/17).

This contribution was added in [SnakeYAML 2.4](https://bitbucket.org/snakeyaml/snakeyaml/wiki/Changes).

Basically I propose to : 
- update SnakeYAML version to 2.4
- add testing for yaml duplication check (just capture and check logging)

What do you think @radcortez ? is it acceptable?

Thanks in advance.

Threads would accumulate when pisugarx is disabled/enabled.

 - Test performance with large numbers of file operations
 - Validate error handling for inaccessible files
